messages:
lina: Kicking off config-only canary for batching + routing tweaks. Rollout id: canary-2026-03-21-01. Targets: us-east, eu-west. Key params: batch_window_ms 20->15, concurrency_shaper 0.8->0.6, kv_cache_ttl 120->60, geo_affinity: prefer-eu for eu tenants. 15m canary, observability hooks on.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by lina — canary-2026-03-21-01 (config-only). No code changes. Started at 1768456789. Logs + status: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploys/canary-2026-03-21-01

aj: ack — watching p95/p99 token latency and tail behaviors. Will alert if p95 > 450ms or p99 delta > 100ms.

marc: Adding tracepoints to routing decision path. Quick Q: any model pin changes? want to confirm we keep model versions locked.

serena: No model pins involved. This touches routing weights, batch window, and concurrency shaper only. Config snippet: ```yaml
rollout_id: canary-2026-03-21-01
targets: [us-east, eu-west]
params:
  batch_window_ms: 15
  concurrency_shaper: 0.6
  kv_cache_ttl: 60
  routing:
    geo_affinity: prefer-eu
```

sam: product note — goal is to reduce unit cost for high-concurrency tenants while keeping latency stable; watch billing tags and tenant-level overrides.

deploy-bot: Canary progress update: phase 1 (us-east) succeeded initial validation checks, phase 2 (eu-west) roll starting. Metrics: request rate normal, error rate 0.0%.

aj: Observing slight tail-latency increase in us-east for small sequences (<64): p99 from ~820ms -> ~920ms (delta ~100ms). Inference node CPU +5%. Checking whether batching alignment changed due to window shrink.

serena: Hmm. If small sequences are getting worse, we can patch a targeted revert just for us-east. Suggest revert batch_window_ms back to 20 in us-east while leaving eu-west. That isolates risk.

lina: Agree — prefer targeted rollback in us-east first. Plan: 1) partial rollback to previous config in us-east, 2) keep eu-west canary running, 3) monitor 10m and decide promote or full rollback. No global rollback unless we see regressions in eu-west.

deploy-bot: Applied partial rollback for canary-2026-03-21-01 in us-east at 1768456860. Status: us-east reverted to previous batch_window_ms=20. eu-west remains on new config. Patch id: cfg-abc123.

marc: Verified — us-east p99 back to baseline after rollback. Traces show routing alignment corrected.

aj: :thumbsup: continuing to monitor. Will post if any secondary effects show up (KV cache hit-rate, throughput per GPU).

sam: Please add a short note to release notes: "Cost-optimizing batching + routing tweak (canary). Partial rollback applied for us-east due to p99 tail latency; eu-west remains under test." Also tag oncall contacts.

lina: Added to release notes and the deploy summary. Will schedule a quick retro if eu-west shows anomalies. Thanks team :eyes:
